class.name: PCKPackageExporter
class.keywords: pck, pack, dlc, mod, export, description
class.brief_description: Builds a [PCKPackage] description into a pack through the export pipeline of an export preset.

method.name: export_description
method.description: Builds [param description] into a pack at [param target_path], with the export pipeline of the export preset named [param preset_name] (see [method get_preset_names]). [param debug] exports like a debug export. If [param include_dependencies] is [code]false[/code], only the listed [code]res://[/code] files (with their own [code].import[/code], [code].remap[/code] and imported files) are packed, not the files they depend on; use it when the main game already ships them. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if there is no such preset. See [method export_description_with_preset] for the other errors.

method.name: export_description_with_preset
method.description: Like [method export_description], with an [EditorExportPreset], for example the one an [EditorExportPlugin] gets from [method EditorExportPlugin.get_export_preset]. The preset is never changed: the export uses a temporary copy that is not added to the project's presets. This method may be called during another export, for example from an export plugin. The export plugins' [method EditorExportPlugin._export_begin] and [method EditorExportPlugin._export_end] are then not called a second time, so they keep the state of the running export. Outside an export, they are called for the build like for "Export PCK/ZIP". Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a null description or preset, an empty target path or a description that can't be built (see [method plan_description]), [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if a source file is missing, [constant ERR_BUSY] while another description is built, the project is scanned or [param target_path] is mounted, [constant ERR_FILE_MISSING_DEPENDENCIES] if the export wrote nothing for a listed file (it is excluded by the preset's exclude filter or skipped by an export plugin), and [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] outside the editor or without a matching export platform.

method.name: export_target_to_res_path
method.description: Returns the [code]res://[/code] path of the export target [param export_path], or an empty string if the target is outside the project folder [param project_dir]. Export paths may be relative to the project folder, [code]res://[/code] paths or absolute paths; backslashes are accepted. The comparison with [param project_dir] ignores case. [codeblock] PCKPackageExporter.export_target_to_res_path("build/game.pck", "C:/Projects/Game") # "res://build/game.pck" PCKPackageExporter.export_target_to_res_path("../builds/game.pck", "C:/Projects/Game") # "" [/codeblock]

method.name: find_preset
method.description: Returns the export preset of the project named [param name], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_export_target_paths
method.description: Returns the [code]res://[/code] paths of the export targets of all presets that lie inside the project folder. For a target that is not a [code].pck[/code] or [code].zip[/code] file (an executable), the [code].pck[/code] next to it is listed too. These files are never exported.

method.name: get_preset_names
method.description: Returns the names of the project's export presets, in the order of the Export dialog.

method.name: is_building
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a description is built. Export plugins can use it to tell a pack build from a normal export.

method.name: is_export_target
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] (a [code]res://[/code] path or a path relative to [code]res://[/code]) is listed by [method get_export_target_paths].

method.name: is_exporting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while an export runs, from the export plugins' [method EditorExportPlugin._export_begin] to their [method EditorExportPlugin._export_end].

method.name: matches_encryption_filters
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] matches one of [param include_filters] and none of [param exclude_filters], with the rules of the export's encryption filters: [code]*[/code] and [code]?[/code] wildcards, case-insensitive, matched against the path with and without [code]res://[/code]. [codeblock] PCKPackageExporter.matches_encryption_filters("res://dlc/a.pck", ["*"], ["*.pck"]) # false [/codeblock]

method.name: plan_description
should_encrypt
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param preset] encrypts the file at [param path] in its packs: the preset's "Encrypt Exported PCK" option is on and [method matches_encryption_filters] matches its include and exclude filters. Returns [code]false[/code] for a null preset.
